summary: A distributed generative-art system evolves abstract animations using viewer votes as a genetic-algorithm fitness signal.

correction: Interactive human selection and static shape generation do not establish autonomous ecology or agent cognition.

summary: User-designed virtual creatures are optimized through evolutionary algorithms in a sandbox simulation.
verification_note: Author repository description reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Separate body construction by the user from evolved controller behavior; no automatic evolution of unrestricted morphology established.

summary: Action roguelite uses material-based pixel simulation alongside rigid-body, thermal, electrical and simplified chemical interactions.
verification_note: Developer homepage and FAQ reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Materials simulation and procedural worlds do not make it an autonomous evolution platform.

summary: Users collaboratively evolve images, share results, and branch from other users' designs.
verification_note: Read primary paper abstract on collaborative interactive evolution.
correction: Human judgment drives selection. Broad exploration is not equivalent to autonomous unbounded evolution.

summary: Browser-based creative cellular-automata sandbox lets users combine simulated materials into interactive scenes.
verification_note: Author repository identity and description reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Creative materials simulation does not itself demonstrate heredity, selection, or autonomous open-ended evolution.

summary: Ant-colony simulation combines player control, foraging, territorial competition, predators, and colony management.
verification_note: Archived original manual introduction and game descriptions reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Correct subtitle is Electronic, not Electric. Reproducing ants and colony growth differ from genetic evolutionary search.

summary: Planet-scale simulation couples geosphere, atmosphere, climate, broad life classes, and civilization over selectable timescales.
verification_note: Original manual text hosted by an archive reviewed at contents/model-section level. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: A coarse planetary model; its evolution mechanics are not per-organism inherited genomes.

summary: Ecosystem simulation lets players alter organisms' genetics and environmental conditions and observe adaptation and population change.
verification_note: Archived original 1992 Maxis correspondence and product materials reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Publisher claims establish intended features, not independently validated scientific fidelity; avoid marketing superlatives.

summary: Evolution sandbox simulates creatures that mutate, reproduce and respond to environmental selection, with player intervention.

summary: Commercial creation game lets players design creatures and progress through several scales of an imagined life history.
verification_note: Publisher product page reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Player-guided creature design is not evidence of autonomous Darwinian evolution; avoid declaring absence of all inheritance mechanisms.

summary: An interactive artificial-life artwork populated a virtual environment with creatures assembled by online participants.
verification_note: Creator article title and indexed description reviewed; full text was not retrieved.
correction: Historical art/ecology comparison only; no claim about current software availability or detailed evolutionary mechanisms.

summary: Particle-physics sandbox simulates materials, heat, air pressure, and interactions in user-created scenes.
verification_note: Official repository identity and description reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: A general sandbox; user-built life-like contraptions should not be conflated with built-in evolutionary ecology.

summary: Open-source evolution game combines organism editing with simulated environmental competition; its documented development focuses on early life stages.
verification_note: Official developer wiki reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Seven stages are a roadmap, not delivered scope. Avoid asserting current playable stages beyond a versioned release check.

summary: Household-based archaeological simulation studies population and settlement patterns in Long House Valley using reconstructed environmental conditions.
verification_note: Primary article's indexed title, authors, date and DOI reviewed; direct full text encountered a browser challenge. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.

summary: A computational biology package supports cell populations, tissue modeling and cardiac electrophysiology with extensible scientific software.
verification_note: Official package overview reviewed.
correction: Biological fidelity and validation are separate from general-purpose ALife breadth.

summary: A scriptable virtual-tissue modeling environment uses Cellular Potts dynamics for multiscale multicellular simulations.
verification_note: Official About section reviewed.
correction: Compare coupled tissue mechanics and biological modeling; capabilities of a framework depend on the chosen model.

summary: Open-science project studies developmental dynamics, digital morphogenesis, and developmental plasticity, with a strong focus on C. elegans.
verification_note: Official OpenWorm project documentation reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: An affiliated research program with several efforts, not a single complete coupled organism simulator. Shared family with OpenWorm.

summary: Coupled reaction-diffusion equations generate spatial patterns, including spots that can split.
verification_note: Munafo's own research presentation includes moving and splitting patterns.
correction: 1993 refers to Pearson's pattern study, not the origin of all Gray-Scott chemistry; splitting spots is not genetic reproduction.

summary: A learned local update rule grows target patterns from seeds and can support persistence and regeneration.
verification_note: Original 2020 article and training variants reviewed.
correction: Training a developmental rule is not evidence of an organism learning during life or reproducing with heritable variation.

summary: A modeling environment couples cell-based models, ordinary differential equations and reaction-diffusion systems with a graphical experiment workflow.
verification_note: Official feature list and principal publication summary reviewed.
correction: A strong counterexample to treating coupled modeling formalisms as unique to CQM; not an autonomous evolved ecosystem by default.

summary: Cellular-automata framework models morphogenesis using nested neighborhoods to represent local and broader contextual signals.
verification_note: Author-hosted technical presentation reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Replace secondary bibliographic page with author source; capability objectives are not all demonstrated outcomes.

summary: Open-source research integrates nervous-system, muscle, soft-tissue, and fluid models toward a simulated C. elegans.
verification_note: Official site explicitly describes ongoing component development and DevoWorm's relationship.
correction: Describe an ongoing modeling effort; do not imply that every component forms a validated complete organism.

summary: Agent-based simulator couples cellular mechanics and phenotypes to diffusing biochemical substrates for studies of multicellular systems.
verification_note: Original 2018 paper abstract and metadata reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Here 'substrates' includes diffusible chemical species; do not translate that directly into a computational-substrate superiority score.

summary: A scriptable, genetically explicit evolutionary simulation framework models population genetics and customizable ecological scenarios.
verification_note: Maintainer repository and author manual description reviewed.
correction: Genetic evolution is explicit; artificial agent cognition and morphology are not default capabilities.

summary: An interactive particle-based environment models physics, chemistry and biology across subcellular, cellular and tissue scales.
verification_note: Official documentation introduction and cited publication reviewed.
correction: Compare interaction among modeling scales; physics and chemistry features alone do not imply evolution or cognition.

summary: Living cell assemblies exhibit designed behaviors; experiments show kinematic replication by gathering loose cells into new motile assemblies.
verification_note: Original 2021 paper's significance statement and metadata reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Physical biological cells, not purely digital organisms. Replication relies on supplied cells and controlled conditions, not unbounded autonomous reproduction.

summary: Formal theoretical-computer-science model expresses a version of global workspace theory using a mathematical machine architecture.
verification_note: Authors' abstract and submission history reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: A formal consciousness model is not evidence that a machine is conscious. Remove 'adopted by nobody' and unsupported numeric theory superiority.

summary: Cognitive architecture and software framework model perception, attention, memory, action selection and learning through global-workspace mechanisms.
verification_note: Developer project and framework documentation reviewed, including reported experiment-replication work. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Theory-inspired architecture is not proof of consciousness. Remove unsupported adoption claims and ordinal consciousness ranking.

summary: Accelerated reinforcement-learning benchmark provides procedurally generated survival and crafting environments with complex skill dependencies.
verification_note: ICML 2024 primary proceedings page and abstract reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Open-ended benchmark terminology is distinct from demonstrating open-ended evolution or self-reproduction.

summary: A voxel-based benchmark evaluates joint optimization of robot morphology and control across locomotion and manipulation tasks.
verification_note: Original author project page and paper abstract reviewed.
correction: Use 2021 NeurIPS publication rather than 2022 preprint deposit as project date; benchmark is not an autonomous ecosystem.

summary: Language-model agents combine memories, reflection and planning to produce behavior in an interactive small-town simulation.
verification_note: Authors' paper abstract reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.
correction: Believable social behavior is not evidence of consciousness, ecological realism, or Darwinian evolution.

summary: Learned world model generates action-controllable environments from visual prompts using training on unlabelled video.
verification_note: Authors' 2024 abstract reviewed. Review covers identity and conservative description, not an independent runtime reproduction.

summary: Evaluation suite tests social generalization of reinforcement-learning agents across scenarios involving cooperation, competition and resource sharing.
